title: How to open an Advertising business in Portugal | Rauva

facts.fact: The page states that in 2023 an estimated 1,200 new advertising companies entered the Portuguese market, as reported by the National Institute of Statistics (INE).
facts.quote: In 2023, Portugal saw a significant increase in the number of advertising businesses, with an estimated 1,200 new companies entering the market, as reported by the National Institute of Statistics (INE).

facts.fact: According to PwC's Global Entertainment and Media Outlook, the Portuguese advertising market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 5.1% from 2023 to 2027.
facts.quote: the Portuguese advertising market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 5.1% from 2023 to 2027, reaching approximately 1.5 billion euros by the end of this forecast period.

facts.fact: According to PwC's Global Entertainment and Media Outlook, the Portuguese advertising market is projected to reach approximately 1.5 billion euros by the end of the 2023-2027 forecast period.
facts.quote: reaching approximately 1.5 billion euros by the end of this forecast period.

facts.fact: Rauva states that within 15 days of company registration, a business must establish a business account and set up certified accounting.
facts.quote: Within 15 days of your company’s registration, you need to establish a business account for your transactions and set up certified accounting.

facts.fact: Rauva states its business account allows payments to be made and received in over 40 currencies.
facts.quote: You can enjoy a business account for making and receiving payments in over 40 currencies, along with tailored invoicing and accounting services.

facts.fact: The page states that a personal Número de Identificação Fiscal (NIF) is required for any entrepreneur wishing to operate legally in Portugal.
facts.quote: you’ll need a personal Número de Identificação Fiscal (NIF). This is essential for any entrepreneur wishing to operate legally in Portugal.
